purpose: Single source of truth for the Ollama runtime options that decide whether a loaded runner can be reused. Ollama restarts a model's runner whenever a request carries different load options, so callers never choose them: the daemon applies the server values to every runner, and the gateway and activity edge send exactly RequestOptions (a declared context above the server default) for each model, replacing any caller-supplied load options.
